author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಿಡಿಗೇಡಿತನದಿಂದ ಮನಸುಗಳ ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿರೆ
ನಡೆಯುವವು ಸತ್ಯವಿಹ ಒಮ್ಮುಖದ ದಾರಿ
ಕಡೆಯೆ ಜನಮನವೆಲ್ಲ ಗರಳಸುಧೆ ತೇಲುವವು
ಪಡೆವೆ ನಿನ್ನಯ ದಾರಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you protect minds from mischief-making,
they will walk the single road where truth lies;
when the minds of people are churned, poison and nectar both float up;
you will find your own way, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Guard minds against troublemaking and they stay on the road of truth. As in the churning of the ocean, stirring people up brings both poison and nectar; choose your own path wisely.
